headline: Papua New Guinea Coconut Corporation Signs China Export Agreement
summary: Kokonas Indastri Koporesen signed a strategic agreement with China Shanghai E.I.C. Business Consultancy Group in Shanghai to facilitate commercial entry for PNG coconut products into China.
why: Agricultural export partnerships help PNG producers expand access to major East Asian consumer markets.

impacts.name: Papua New Guinea
impacts.why: Access to Chinese retail channels supports domestic agricultural export growth.
